title: Horizontal differential of explicit subset insertion
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f:Fin r → A, and J an integer cochain complex of module sheaves on Spec A. Use the explicit subset coordinates, insertion, restriction and union V of [def-sc-principal-open-cech-subset-insertion]. Let U_i be the preimage in V of D(f_i), K the tuple bicomplex [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex] of the restricted complex, and H the forgetful functor to additive groups. Given D_S≤D_(S erase j) for every S,j and the degree equality n+1-|S erase j|=n+2-|S| when j∈S, for every n and coordinate function s, H(K.D₁(n,n+1))(insert_n(s)) equals insert_(n+1) of the function with S coordinate the sum over j∈S of (-1)^|{i∈S:i<j}| times restriction to D_S of s_(S erase j), transported with the given equality. Empty deletions contribute zero. There is no coefficient-differential term.

source.place: Tag 08C1 and equation-global-sections-to-alternating-cech (08C0); Tag 01FG, ordered-complex differential preceding Definition 20.23.2; coordinate verification of the horizontal part of the parent proof. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08C1, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08C0 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01FG.

proof.text: For one source subset S₀, expand principalSubsetInsertOne. Prove p+q=n and (p+1)+q=n+1 from nonemptiness. Apply HomologicalComplex₂.ι_D₁ and d₁_eq. The horizontal sign is 1. Use HomologicalComplex.extend_d_eq and CochainComplex.of_d to identify the map between the two nonnegative columns with alternatingCechDifferential, and cancel the inverse/hom extension isomorphisms. Apply the ordered face calculation for that one supported tuple.

Construct the displayed subset boundary as an additive homomorphism b:coordinates(n)→coordinates(n+1). Its zero and additivity laws follow termwise from restriction, equality transport, and scalar multiplication. Expand insertion as its finite sum of source summands and apply the preceding one-source calculation to each term. The coordinate function s equals the finite sum of Pi.single S (s S). Additivity of b and insertion reassembles the result as insert_(n+1)(b(s)).

lean.statement:
theorem principalSubsetInsertion_horizontal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (J : CochainComplex (Spec (.of A)).Modules ℤ) :
    let V := principalSubsetUnion A r f
    let U : Fin r → V.toScheme.Opens := fun i ↦ V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i)
    let K := (alternatingCechDoubleFunctor U).obj (principalSubsetRestriction A r f J)
    let H := forget₂
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) AddCommGrpCat
    let D := principalSubsetOpen A r f
    ∀ (hle : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), D S ≤ D (S.erase j))
      (he : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), j ∈ S → ∀ n : ℤ,
        n + 1 - ((S.erase j).card : ℤ) = n + 1 + 1 - (S.card : ℤ))
      (n : ℤ) (s : principalSubsetCoordinates A r f J n),
      (H.map (K.D₁ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n (n + 1)))
        (principalSubsetInsertion A r f J n s) =
      principalSubsetInsertion A r f J (n + 1) (fun S ↦
          ∑ j : S.val, if h : (S.val.erase j.val).Nonempty then
            (-1 : A) ^ ((S.val.filter (fun i ↦ i < j.val)).card) •
              (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.map
                (homOfLE (hle S.val j.val)).op
                ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map
                  (eqToHom (congrArg J.X (he S.val j.val j.property n)))).hom.app
                    (op (D (S.val.erase j.val))) (s ⟨S.val.erase j.val, h⟩))
          else 0)
